newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: SRI LANKA SEEKS TO BOOST WATER SALES TO MALDIVES.
newsitem.headline: SRI LANKA SEEKS TO BOOST WATER SALES TO MALDIVES.

text.p: Sri Lanka is to focus on expanding its mineral water industry to cater to a rising demand in neighbouring Maldives, a senior official of the Investment Development Board (IDB) told Reuters on Thursday.
The IDB began encouraging mineral water sales to the Maldives in 1996 and local firms earned 100 million rupees in that year from exports, General Manager Keerthi Senaratne said.
"The IDB is geared to boosting expanding export markets and has targeted Maldives for mineral water," he said.
Senaratne said that the export of mineral water was extremely profitable as good quality water was available in Sri Lanka with potential for high value addition.
The Maldives, an archipelago of some 1,200 coral islands, mostly rely on rain for drinking water since they have few natural sources.
